source_attribution: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, 2021-07-28 statement, extracted HTML text.

claims.text: 联邦基金利率目标区间维持在 0 至 1/4 百分比（0%–0.25%），并将维持至劳动市场条件达到目标。

citations.quotation: The Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent and expects it will be appropriate to maintain this target range until labor market conditions have

claims.text: 美联储将继续推进资产购买以支持其充分就业和物价稳定目标，并在未来会议上评估进展；经济已朝这些目标取得进展。

citations.quotation: Since then, the economy has made progress toward these goals, and the Committee will continue to assess progress in coming meetings. These asset purchases help foster smooth market functioning

counterarguments.text: 所提供的摘录为部分文本，未包含每月国债和机构抵押贷款支持证券的具体购买金额（通常为至少每月 800 亿美元国债和 400 亿美元 MBS），因此无法从给定资料确认这些数字。

citations.quotation: These asset purchases help foster smooth market functioning

counterarguments.text: 摘录中明确指出利率维持需等到劳动市场条件（恢复）——这本身表明声明中劳动市场尚未完全恢复，构成剩余风险/未恢复领域，但摘录未具体列出其他风险如通胀或疫情影响的原文表述。
